predecessors.name: Ife Empire
predecessors.text: Ijebu kingdom around Ijebu-Ode, stretching to parts of present-day Lagos State and bordering Ondo State; earthworks (Eredo) eventually enclosed the whole kingdom; modern Ijebu districts of Ogun State…

successors.name: Lagos Colony
successors.text: Ijebu kingdom around Ijebu-Ode, stretching to parts of present-day Lagos State and bordering Ondo State; earthworks (Eredo) eventually enclosed the whole kingdom; modern Ijebu districts of Ogun State…

ledger.x: 15th century: the Ijebu kingdom is formed.
1892 (12 May): the British land at Epe.

wars.name: Ijebu Expedition
wars.outcome: British victory: landing at Epe 12 May 1892, Ijebu Ode captured, Awujale surrendered 'shortly afterward'; the kingdom annexed (undated) to the colony of Southern Nigeria.

certainty.note: No page gives a frontier; the shape is a circle round the capital.
